analysis.original_request: 我正在为多光谱成像相机设计一片可见-近红外双波段分光膜。要求可见光波段 450-650 nm 尽可能高的反射率（用于 RGB 通道成像），同时近红外波段 700-1000 nm 尽可能高的透过率（用于 NIR 通道），降低通道间串扰。请在 45 度入射、熔融石英基底条件下，仅使用 TiO2 和 SiO2 设计一个平面多层介质膜，膜系总层数不超过 24 层。
analysis.normalized_request_english: Design a planar multilayer dielectric coating for a multispectral imaging camera using TiO2 and SiO2 on a fused silica substrate. The design requires high reflectance in the 450-650 nm band and high transmittance in the 700-1000 nm band at 45 degrees incidence, with a maximum of 24 layers.
analysis.compatibility_reason: Request specifies planar isotropic layered media solvable by transfer matrix method.

validation_warnings: unrequested numeric assumptions were replaced with unspecified
